mode.description: Operation mode: analyze, capture, bruteforce, heuristics, or dictionary.

pcap_file.description: Path to the input/output pcap file.

interface.description: Wireless interface name for capture mode.

key_length.description: WEP key length in bits (64 or 128).

bssid.description: Target BSSID in hex format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

include_fcs.description: Whether packets include a 1-byte FCS tail.

caplen.description: Maximum bytes per packet to log during capture.

multiprocess_threads.description: Number of threads for bruteforce attacks.

specific_attacks.description: Comma-separated list of attack numbers (1-17) to run in heuristics mode.

debug_key.description: Known key for debugging statistical attacks.
